skillType.name: Armor
skillType.desc: Advanced alloys reduce damage taken by attacks.

skillType.name: Barrier
skillType.desc: Creates a protective barrier around units.

skillType.name: Barrier All
skillType.desc: Creates a protective barrier around all allied units.

skillType.name: Strike
skillType.desc: Launches a missile at a random enemy unit.

skillType.name: Strike All
skillType.desc: Launches missiles at all enemy units.

skillType.name: Suppress
skillType.desc: Smoke screen reduces the effectiveness of a random enemy unit's attack.

skillType.name: Suppress All
skillType.desc: Smoke screen reduces the effectiveness of all enemy units' attacks.

skillType.name: Mark
skillType.desc: Increase damage dealt to a random enemy unit.

skillType.name: Mark All
skillType.desc: Increase damage dealt to all enemy units.

skillType.name: Rally
skillType.desc: Increases the attack of a random allied unit.

skillType.name: Rally All
skillType.desc: Increases the attack of all allied units.

skillType.name: Camouflage
skillType.desc: Active camouflage allows a unit to evade enemy skills.

skillType.name: Retaliate
skillType.desc: When attacked on an enemy's turn, this unit will attack back.

skillType.name: Incendiary
skillType.desc: Target takes fire damage over time.

skillType.name: Berserk
skillType.desc: Damage is increased after each successful attack.

skillType.name: Blitz
skillType.desc: Unit is able to attack immediately after being deployed.

skillType.name: Cover
skillType.desc: Unit will move to unprotected lanes.

skillType.name: Flank
skillType.desc: Unit will move to unprotected enemy lanes.

skillType.name: Laser
skillType.desc: Attacks target all units in a lane.

skillType.name: Pierce
skillType.desc: High-velocity weaponry pierces through armor.

skillType.name: Shrapnel
skillType.desc: Attacks cause additional damage to adjacent units.
